name: ClipVault 1.1.0
body:
### Added

- **Update checks.** ClipVault asks GitHub once a day whether a newer release
  exists and surfaces it in Settings → Advanced and the menu-bar menu. It never
  installs anything by itself — ad-hoc signing makes silent self-replacement a
  trust hole, and `brew upgrade --cask clipvault` already does upgrades
  properly. The check is a single unauthenticated request to api.github.com and
  can be turned off.
- **Homebrew install**: `brew install --cask soumyasc/tap/clipvault`. The cask in
  [SoumyaSC/homebrew-tap](https://github.com/SoumyaSC/homebrew-tap) is refreshed
  on every `release.sh --publish`, with the checksum taken from the asset GitHub
  actually serves rather than the local build.
- **Screenshots in the README**, generated by `Scripts/make_screenshots.sh`. It
  seeds a throwaway history with demo content through the real capture path and
  renders the shipping views — no real clipboard item can reach a public page.
- `Scripts/release.sh --publish` now pushes, publishes the GitHub release with
  the changelog section as its notes, and refreshes the Homebrew cask.

### Changed

- Settings tabs can be addressed programmatically (`SettingsView(initialTab:)`),
  which is what lets the renderer capture each tab.
- `CV_DATA_DIR` and `CV_DEFAULTS_SUITE` point a launch at a scratch history and
  preferences suite. Unset in normal use; they exist so screenshots and manual QA
  can never touch real data.
